lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: This is the hammock where Frima always sleeps.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Do you want us to chew her out for not cleaning?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: What then?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: We're going to borrow her hammock.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: If nothing else,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: you've certainly kept me guessing today.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Okay, take me through it.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: First, lie down in it.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: After taking a deep breath,

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Helm tries to lie down on the hammock.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: *Squeak*

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Gah!

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: *Collapse*

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Argh!

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Sorry, I'll try again.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: It's okay. Take your time.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Er...

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: ... Aren't you angry?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Why would I be?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I already failed to do one job you asked me to do today,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: and now I ended up tripping you because I couldn't even do something as simple as laying down in a hammock.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: If it were me, I would have been apoplectic.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I'd have chewed you out like I usually do with Anchor and Mast.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: You've never used a hammock before.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: That's no excuse.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Nikke's somatic functions are superior to humans in many ways.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: It's preposterous that I can't pull off such a simple physical task.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Why are you always so hard on yourself?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: can't stand the notion of failure.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Think about it, Subordinate.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: The Aegis Squad is responsible for the only battleship in the entire Ark.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Our maintenance costs are far and above the greatest of any squad.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: It's an immense amount of responsibility, and it's all in the hands of just three people: me, Anchor, and Mast.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: As you can imagine, all sorts of incidents are popping up as a result.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: When something goes wrong, no one tells us that it's okay because it's our first time.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Not even once.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Our job consumes a lot of resources and manpower.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Saying you're sorry only gets you so far.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: So everything has to be planned down to the finest detail.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: ... Either it's us, or our squad.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Okay, but working this way has made you a nervous wreck,

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: and you're passing that negative energy onto Mast and Anchor.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: But what else can I do?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I can't shirk my responsibilities simply because I'm stressed out.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Mast, Anchor, the Admire,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Deputy Chief Burningum, who works so hard to maintain our squad,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: all of our sponsors who are kind enough to donate to our case, and...

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: You can lean on me.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Those people are not your responsibility.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: If anything, they're supposed to back you up in times of need.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: But I...

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I've never thought of it that way.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Try to change your mindset.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Trusting the people around you is not as bad as you may think.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I feel so bad.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Bad that I couldn't even climb into a simple hammock.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: That you look so disheveled and your uniform is soiled due to my mistake.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: That even though you've been so patient with me,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: nothing is working out as you probably hoped.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I guess it's okay to feel bad sometimes.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Because there are always people who will accept you for who you are, warts and all. Like you.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: My squadmates would probably have done the same thing if they were here.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: They must be hoping that I'll treat them in kind.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Rather than being pushy, fretful, and angry all the time... I should be the kind of leader who has faith in their colleagues.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Is this why you made me do all these strange things today?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: So that I'd come to this realization?
It's about time.
It took a while, but now you're getting it.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: ... Subordinate！

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I just had a minor revelation, and you're making fun of me already?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I could never joke at a time like this.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: You'll get used to it.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: No I won't.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Because I'm not going to let this ever happen again.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Laughing it off after making mistakes can only happen once.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Again.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I'm sorry, I know it mustn't have been easy dealing with me.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: But from now on, I'll try my best.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I'm a quick learner.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Now give getting into that hammock another spin.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Helm stands up.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Spread it out with your hands and then sit on it first.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: *Squeak*

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: That was easier than I thought it'd be.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I think I failed the first time because I tried to lie down straight away.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: So now all I need to do is swing my legs over, right?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: *Squeak*

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Gah, it's shaking all over the place!

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Grab the ropes on both sides.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Got it!

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Heh...

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: It's much more stable now.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Gosh, how dumb could I have been to try and lay straight down on this thing?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I have to say, it's pretty comfortable.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: It feels like I'm being wrapped in a cozy blanket.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Best of all, I can look straight up at the night sky.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: The wind against my face, the Milky Way high up in the sky...

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Usually I'd only get to see this kind of view on the deck of the Admire.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Oh, jeez, I just realized that I've been hogging this hammock all to myself.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Do you want to join me?
Of course.
Unfortunately, it's only meant for one.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: It's a little narrow, but I'll make some room for you.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: I was just joking.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Sorry. I take things a bit too literally sometimes.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: That's fine. I can get up and you can lie down.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: I'm not particularly interested in that.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Oh?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Then how about we sit next to each other?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I think there's enough room for the two of us if we're sitting.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: *Rustle*

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Helm scooches over to the side.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Hmm... it's a bit narrower than I expected.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: It'll be a tight squeeze.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Are you okay with that?
I am if you are.
I'm more than okay with it.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I'm fine with it.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Otherwise, I wouldn't have asked you in the first place.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Makes sense.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: After all, you've been around Nikkes enough.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I'm sure you've gotten used to this sort of thing.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Let me get in here, then.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: *Rustle*

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: I sit down next to Helm and start to lean back.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Wait, don't lean against it, or the rope might...!

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Huh, I thought it would break, but it didn't.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: This hammock is more durable than you think.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Apparently.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Then let me try.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: *Rustle*

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Helm leans back.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: ... Feels good.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: This is much more comfortable than sitting upright.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: This would be perfect for cozying up with a good book.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: It feels nice to be close to you as well, and feel the warmth of your body...

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: What's the matter?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Nothing.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I just remembered something I'd forgotten earlier.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I... I'm sorry, but may I go now?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I think that's enough instruction for today.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I shouldn't take up more of your time.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I'll see you around.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Helm gets up hastily and leaves.
